offset.description: Offset of the starting record. 0 indicates the first record.

attributeTypeId.description: The attribute type id. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=AttributeTypes

attributeType.description: The attribute type. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=AttributeTypes

attributeDataTypeId.description: The attribute data type id. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=AttributeDataTypes

attributeDataType.description: The attribute data type. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=AttributeDataTypes

isRequired.description: Indicates if the attribute is required

isRestricted.description: Indicates if the attribute is editable only by Security Leads

defaultValue.description: Default value for the attribute when both isRequired and isRestricted are true

picklistValues.description: A list of attribute item values

id.description: The id of the attribute item value

name.description: The name of the attribute item value
